$about: Every element and component of the MNG Web Design System, present and future, for the README's Inventory section. Edit here; build.py renders it and checks that every built component is listed as In system or Partial. Figma component lists read with the Desktop Bridge plugin on 2026-10-29 (main file and WordPress Elements); Reader Dashboard v2.0 from Reader-Dashboard-Library-Impact-Map.md: its audit isn't complete (Karl, 2026-10-29). Obits isn't connected to the system yet; audit it in the future.

statuses.In system: Built here, with a live preview card.
statuses.Partial: Built here, but only part of the Figma component or family.
statuses.To add: In Figma; not built here yet.
statuses.To review: In Figma, but old, duplicated or unclear: decide before building.
statuses.Not a component: Reference, template, mock-up of OS or third-party UI, or kept on purpose; not planned for the system.
statuses.Removed: Left out of the system on purpose.
